messages:
jordan: FYI: planned prod deployment tonight in the change window (22:00 UTC). Freezing config + feature flags at 21:00 UTC. Quick preflight checklist below, please ack if anything blocks. :eyes:

priya: ack — I'm on alerts and can sit on the rollback lane. can we pin model->v2.3.1 for this rollout?

liam: +1 for pin. v2.4 has a perf regression in our perf run earlier, pin to v2.3.1 for stability.

jordan: pin decision: v2.3.1 pinned for the release. tagging release notes: https://internal.docs/release/2026-11-03-ml-infra :memo:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @jordan for 2026-11-03T22:00:00Z in env=prod. Canary group: 5% traffic for 10m -> 50% -> 100%. Auto-rollback thresholds: error-rate > 2x baseline OR latency p95 > 2000ms for 3 consecutive minutes. :robot_face:

priya: quick checklist I ran locally:
- DB migrations: none
- Config changes: feature flag rollforward (ff:enable-new-tokenizer) -> OFF until canary green
- Infra: autoscaler policy unchanged

liam: on release notes: add note about KV cache warmup and expected warm period ~5k tokens for first requests so latency spike is expected.

sophia: oncall runbook quick reminder: rollback command is `./ops rollback --release v20261103-ml` and then `deploy-bot cancel` if canary still running. Put golden image id in the runbook.

priya: adding a short fallback plan: if we hit the latency threshold, swap traffic to dedicated-runner-1 until we rollback. That runner has older quant that was stable in last 2 weeks.

deploy-bot: NOTE: freeze window enforcement starting 2026-11-03T21:00:00Z. Non-emergency merges will be blocked. Use `#eng-releases` to request exemptions.

jordan: Exemptions: only security hotfixes or legal-required changes. Leave a short rationale.

oncall-bot: oncall rotation: priya -> liam -> sophia for 22:00-02:00 UTC. Pager escalation: pager->#oncall->eng-lead.

liam: canary readiness: infra smoke passed on staging, canary scripts present in /infra/canary/2026-11-03. I will start the canary watch at 22:00.

priya: I've set alerts: error-rate, p95 latency, model-serve cpu, kv cache hitrate. Slack alert channel = #prod-alerts, also webhook to PagerDuty.

jordan: backup plan if rollback needed:
1) execute `./ops rollback --release v20261103-ml`
2) pin model to v2.3.1 (if somehow unpinned) -> `rbac-api pin model redwood/llm v2.3.1`
3) failover traffic to dedicated-runner-1
4) open a postmortem stub in `docs/postmortems/`

priya: also make sure deploy runs with `--no-optimize` flag for the first canary so we can measure baseline (we'll enable optimizations on step to 50%).

sophia: small nit: add rollback marker tag in monitoring so we can filter metrics around rollback window. I'll add `rollback_tag=preflight-20261103` before deploy.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-11-03T22:00:00Z - group 5%. Monitoring pipelines: perf, errors, logs ingest.

liam: canary 5% observing: errors nominal, p95 = 860ms, kv hitrate 78%. no anomalies after 6m. advancing to 50%.

deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 50% at 2026-11-03T22:10:00Z.

priya: 50%: p95 = 920ms, errors +0.1% absolute, within threshold. Holding 10m.

liam: 50% hold complete, pushing to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Release completed at 2026-11-03T22:25:00Z. Pinned model remains v2.3.1.

jordan: post-release checklist:
- confirm canary metrics for 30m -> OK
- update release notes with mitigation steps and rollback commands -> done
- schedule follow-up eval on 2026-11-04 for quality regression tests

sophia: adding note: Ops will keep freeze until 2026-11-04T02:00:00Z to monitor morning traffic in NA. If no issues, we'll lift freeze at that time.

priya: all green from my side. marking as resolved in the thread. :white_check_mark:

liam: thanks all. nice quick canary.

jordan: thanks team. closing out. if anything pops, @priya oncall.
